content.text: {"headline":"Approve P3: full overtime plus all free levers is the only plan that reaches the 80% target (82.5%) during the 13:45-15:45 outage window, at an extra cost of ₹6,708.","why":"Payments calls more than doubled (187 vs 88.5 forecast at 12:45) because of the card authorisation gateway outage (P1 INC-20261001-6607). Card-declined calls are 2.22x normal. With no action, service level over 13:45-15:45 would be 58.5%, with payments at 49.4% and 9.3% of callers abandoning. P3 offers overtime to 30 payments agents from 14:15 to 15:45. It also delays breaks, moves 3 cross-skilled agents from general, cancels coaching, turns on the IVR callback and outage message, and deflects 20% of status enquiries to chat. Together these lift service level to 82.5% (payments 82.1%, general 83.3%) and cut abandons to 4.1%. No policy is breached, and no escalation is needed.","trade_offs":["P2 costs ₹5,088, ₹1,620 less than P3, but reaches only 76.2% (payments 70.4%), below target, with 5.8% abandons.","P1 costs only ₹600 but reaches just 62.0% (payments 53.8%), with 8.6% abandons.","Moving 3 agents out of general in P3 leaves general at 83.3%, lower than P2's 87.3% but still above target. The risk to the other queue is small.","Rest of day improves to 91.0% under P3, versus 79.6% with no action."],"watch":"P3 depends on overtime uptake: if fewer than 30 agents accept, service level will likely fall toward P2's 76.2%. Track overtime take-up and payments service level from 14:15. Also watch the gateway failover on INC-20261001-6607; if card-declined volumes stay high past 15:45, reassess."}
